summary.practice_suggestion: For the next omni-cede or agent build, run a deliberate prefix-cache experiment: structure prompts with a stable system+context prefix and measure latency/cost delta with cache hit vs cold call. The mechanical understanding of KV cache economics will sharpen how you architect long-loop graph memory traffic, and the eval pattern transfers directly to production drift measurement.
